strains.name: Covert Boats & Hoes
strains.genetics: G-Walk (Florida OG × Grease Monkey) × Chem Brulée
strains.profile: Earthy, citrus, diesel; balanced gas-forward hybrid. G-Walk adds OG funk; Chem Brulée delivers petrol/lemon sweetness.
strains.notes: Listed on SEALED list photo (IMG_4485).

strains.name: Tiki Madman Space Runtz
strains.genetics: Runtz (Zkittlez × Gelato) × Candy Rain (London Pound Cake × Gelato)
strains.profile: Sweet candy, violet, pear; caryophyllene-forward. 1st Place Best Med Indica, Connoisseur Cup Denver. Tissue-culture stable line.
strains.notes: Pack labeled 'Tiki Madman'; master list confirms Space Runtz.

strains.name: GSRH (Garlic Sherb)
strains.genetics: GMO (Garlic Cookies = Chem D × GSC) × Blue Sherbet
strains.profile: Garlic, gas, chem, cookies, rubber. Dense trichomes. S1 feminized version available. Tall stretch. Medium–high yield.
strains.notes: On SEALED list; standalone photo not isolated.

strains.name: Drive Thru Wedding
strains.genetics: (Wedding Cake × Gas Powered Sherb) × Chem Brulée
strains.profile: Sweet creamy frosting + diesel; purple & green hues. Wedding Cake = Triangle Mints #23 × Animal Mints.
strains.notes: Confirmed by Covert pack.

strains.name: Envy Pop Rocks
strains.profile: Fruity candy, dense resin; indica-leaning hybrid. BlowPops is Envy's house cross used in many dessert lines.
strains.notes: Two pack photos.

strains.name: Gushers S1
strains.profile: Tropical fruit, sweet candy, cookies; relaxing euphoria. Dense lime-green buds with orange hairs.

strains.name: Runtz S1
strains.profile: Sweet candy, fruity; uplifting cerebral + body relaxation. Balanced hybrid.
strains.notes: Rainbow tin format; appears in both Sealed and Open sections.

strains.name: Cult Classic Fresh Baked
strains.genetics: Purple Goji OG × Freshies (Freshies = Animal Cookies × OGKB × OGKB × Ultraviolet OG)
strains.profile: Doughy, OG-forward, cookies. Fresh Baked = Purple Goji OG × Freshies (confirmed on pack).
strains.notes: Pack text confirms Purple Goji OG × Freshies. Original docx marked pairing unconfirmed — now verified.

strains.name: Cement Shoes S1
strains.genetics: Cement Shoes self-pollinated S1 — Cement Shoes = Animal Cookies × Wedding Pie × Gelato #33
strains.profile: Heavy sedative indica; OG-forward with doughy cookies, gas, and pepper. 'Cement Shoes' name nods to its couch-lock effect.
strains.notes: Not in original docx — added from pack photo.

strains.name: Ethos OGDLUX
strains.genetics: OGKB (GSC pheno) × Triangle Kush × Josh D OG (Triangle Kush × SFV OG × Hells Angels OG) — OG BX project (Bx3)
strains.profile: Heavy petrol with ripe cherry undertones; psychedelic + deep body relaxation. Super-resinous; dense OG stretch.
strains.notes: Pack confirms 'Bx3' backcross generation.

strains.name: Freshmaker
strains.profile: Cult Classics Freshies cross — fruit-forward candy/fruit profile layered over OG cookie backbone.
strains.notes: Not in original docx — added from pack photo.

strains.name: Savage Jr Mintz
strains.profile: Sweet creamy candy with minty finish; indica-leaning hybrid. Frost-heavy, very potent.

strains.name: Cloud Spin
strains.profile: Name suggests hazy/sativa-leaning; no confirmed public lineage.
strains.notes: Not in original docx — added from SEALED list photo (IMG_4485). No individual pack photo identified.

strains.name: ABSeed Goat Cheese
strains.genetics: Commonly: UK Cheese (Skunk #1 pheno) × Golden Goat; some cuts use RS11 in place of Golden Goat
strains.profile: Skunky dairy funk + tropical citrus/pine. Two phenotypes: cheese-dominant (shorter, denser) vs. Goat-dominant (taller, sweeter). Caryophyllene/myrcene forward.
strains.notes: On SEALED list; no dedicated photo located.

strains.name: S. Orange Pucker
strains.genetics: lineage unverified publicly; name suggests sour-citrus cross
strains.profile: Sour orange / citrus pucker profile implied.
strains.notes: Not in original docx — added from SEALED list photo.

strains.name: O. Cookie Violence
strains.profile: Cookie-forward aggressive hybrid implied by name.
strains.notes: Not in original docx — added from SEALED list photo.

strains.name: Jurassic Kush
strains.profile: Kush-forward with Stankasaurus funk; A&B Company wooden-box release with custom glass pendant.
strains.notes: Original docx speculated Hindu Kush/OG Kush ancestry — pack photo confirms Platinum Kush Mints × Stankasaurus.

strains.name: N. Speckley Boogie
strains.profile: Craft/underground release; profile unconfirmed.
strains.notes: Not in original docx — added from SEALED list photo.

strains.name: Bloom Guava Barz
strains.profile: Tropical guava, dank, gassy; sativa-dominant. Energized + creative. Dense trichome coverage.
strains.notes: Pack shows 12 seeds (docx had 4).

strains.name: Nephisto MBAP (ManBearAlienPig)
strains.genetics: 3 Bears OG × Ripley's OG — F3 Feminized Autoflower
strains.profile: Indica-dominant (65/35). Fruity dank OG; wide lateral branching, heavy resin. Insomnia/stress relief. 120–300g yield. LST recommended.
strains.notes: Mephisto Reserva line pack.

strains.name: G. Classics Hitmaker
strains.genetics: Motorbreath × Freshies (Animal Cookies × OGKB × OGKB × Ultraviolet OG)
strains.profile: Gas/OG, garlic, musk, pastry dough; ripe fruit on exhale. Good botrytis/mildew resistance. 500g/m² indoor.
strains.notes: Pack shows 6 seeds (docx had 4). Motorbreath confirmed (Motor Breath #15 lineage).

strains.name: Sunset Freshies
strains.profile: Sunset Strip #3 brings sunset/berry sherbet; Freshies adds OG/cookie backbone. Handwritten '13' on pack.
strains.notes: Pack confirms Sunset Strip #3 (not Sunset Sherbet as docx speculated).

strains.name: GSRH Yahemi

strains.name: Exotic Greezy Runtz
strains.profile: Gassy, fruity Runtz variant; heavier fuel profile than standard Runtz via Grease Monkey reversal.
strains.notes: Pack confirms Grease Monkey reversal (not a 'Greezo' pheno).

strains.name: Crane City S. Socker / The Zit
strains.profile: Crane City pack labeled 'The Zit' — Zkittlez × undisclosed partner. Master-list entry is 'S. Socker'; likely the same Crane City release line.
strains.notes: Name discrepancy: list shows 'S. Socker', photo shows 'The Zit'. Same breeder.

strains.name: Envy Grape Blow
strains.profile: Pungent sweet grape + candy; indica-dominant. Envy's BlowPops used widely in their dessert line.
strains.notes: Pack confirms Grape Pie × BlowPops.

strains.name: Geist Kushmints × Banana06
